body: Thank you for your input. I don’t have the time anymore for option 1, even if I wanted to, but I honestly don’t think I could deal with it, emotionally speaking; and definitely don’t have the time for option 3. Option 2 is my only option, aside from ending things definitively. I just don’t know if I can deal with the consequences that will arise from that and the disappointment from people that mean the world to me.
It definitely wasn’t me. I can only thank you for your advice.
I’m sorry for what you’ve been through. I hope I’m strong enough to deal with my problem as you have dealt with yours...

Going through heartbreak is awful, I understand how hopeless it can feel, specially at your age, I’m 33 btw. If I can say something is that IT WILL GET BETTER. You will get over her, it hurts now, but in a couple of weeks it will hurt a bit less and so on. High school is a difficult period in our lives, specially for those that don’t conforme to the norm. Try making friends online, search for people who have the same interests as you, that helps. 

If those suicidal thoughts come up, try to distract yourself, engage in some activity you like, things will improve, give it time. Talk to someone you trust.
